name: Quarter-Resolution Temporal Upsampling
aliases: Quarter-Resolution Temporal Upsampling for Volumetric Clouds
Upsampling to Improve Volumetric Cloud Render Performance
definition: An optimization technique for real-time volumetric cloud rendering that reduces computational load by rendering to a buffer at one-quarter resolution (1/16th of total pixels) and upscaling to full resolution using temporal reprojection and pixel jittering to maintain visual fidelity.
summary: Quarter-Resolution Temporal Upsampling renders volumetric clouds at one-quarter resolution and uses temporal reprojection with pixel jittering to upscale to full resolution, preserving detail more effectively than standard bilinear upsampling.
